submitted.rationale: Across the five measured compositions, index 1 (Sb 0.143) had the highest EQE at 0.073%. Its neighbour at Sb 0.1225 gave 0.060%, and EQE fell steadily as Sb increased: 0.025% at 0.249, about 0 at 0.49 and 0.008% at 0.70. This places the optimum near Sb 0.14, in the Fe-rich hematite-like region. An untested peak between Sb 0.16 and 0.21 (indices 2–3) is still possible.
